description: This file contains the implementation of the internal dcigettext function, which is part of the gettext internationalization library. It includes functions for message translation, domain handling, locale guessing, and character set conversion, with extensive system and locale-specific logic.

methods.name: DCIGETTEXT
methods.description: Main function to look up translated messages in a message catalog, with support for plural forms and locale-specific handling.

methods.name: _nl_find_msg
methods.description: Finds the message string in a loaded message catalog, with optional character set conversion.

methods.name: _nl_find_domain
methods.description: Locates or loads a message domain (catalog) based on directory, locale, and binding.

methods.name: _nl_load_domain
methods.description: Loads a message catalog domain into memory.

methods.name: _nl_free_domain_conv
methods.description: Frees character set conversion resources for a domain.

methods.name: _nl_init_domain_conv
methods.description: Initializes character set conversion for a domain.

methods.name: _nl_log_untranslated
methods.description: Logs untranslated message IDs if configured.

methods.name: plural_eval
methods.description: Evaluates the plural form expression for a given number.

methods.name: category_to_name
methods.description: Returns the string name of a locale category.

methods.name: guess_category_value
methods.description: Guesses the locale category value based on environment variables.
